info.name: Mist Admins Orgs Stats - Marvis Clients API

params.name: distinct
params.description: Field to count by. enum: `device_id`, `wifi_mac`, `wifi_ip`, `hostname`, `model`, `mfg`, `serial`, `os_type`, `os_version`

params.name: device_id
params.description: Filter by Marvis Client installation device UUID

params.name: wifi_mac
params.description: Filter by device Wi-Fi MAC address

params.name: wifi_ip
params.description: Filter by device Wi-Fi IP address

params.name: hostname
params.description: Filter by device hostname

params.name: model
params.description: Filter by device model

params.name: mfg
params.description: Filter by device manufacturer

params.name: serial
params.description: Filter by device serial number

params.name: os_type
params.description: Filter by device OS type or platform

params.name: os_version
params.description: Filter by device OS version

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per page

params.name: start
params.description: Lower bound of the time range, as an epoch timestamp in seconds or a relative value such as `-1d` or `-1w`

params.name: end
params.description: Upper bound of the time range, as an epoch timestamp in seconds or a relative value such as `-1d`, `-2h`, or `now`

params.name: duration
params.description: Time range duration for the query, using relative units such as `10m`, `7d`, or `2w`
